title: Deadline and Extraction
author: N. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Noor Eastwick, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
